Questions

Common questions

What does an insurance agency do?

We advise you on the cover you need, collect the information insurers require, approach suitable insurers for terms and support you with renewals and claims. The policy itself is issued by the insurer.

What insurance does my business need?

It depends on what you own, who you employ and what you do. Most employers need work injury cover (WIBA), most businesses with premises need property cover and many need liability cover. A short review will give you a clear list.

Do you only work with businesses?

No. Our depth is in business and specialist cover, and we also arrange motor, medical, travel, home and personal accident insurance for individuals and families.

Can you help with a claim?

Yes. We help you understand your policy, prepare documents and follow up with the insurer. We cannot promise a settlement, since that depends on the policy and the facts of the loss.

Not sure what you need? Start with a conversation.

Tell us about your business, your family or your project. An advisor will come back with practical options and plain explanations. No pressure and no jargon.
